an3.12:1.1: tīṇīmāni bhikkhave rañño khattiyassa muddhābhisittassa yāvajīvaṃ saraṇīyāni bhavanti
an3.12:1.3: yasmiṃ bhikkhave padese rājā khattiyo muddhābhisitto jāto hoti
an3.12:1.4: idaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamaṃ rañño khattiyassa muddhābhisittassa yāvajīvaṃ saraṇīyaṃ hoti.
an3.12:2.1: puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave yasmiṃ padese rājā khattiyo muddhābhisitto hoti
an3.12:2.2: idaṃ bhikkhave dutiyaṃ rañño khattiyassa muddhābhisittassa yāvajīvaṃ saraṇīyaṃ hoti.
an3.12:3.1: puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave yasmiṃ padese rājā khattiyo muddhābhisitto saṅgāmaṃ abhivijinitvā vijitasaṅgāmo tameva saṅgāmasīsaṃ ajjhāvasati
an3.12:3.2: idaṃ bhikkhave tatiyaṃ rañño khattiyassa muddhābhisittassa yāvajīvaṃ saraṇīyaṃ hoti.
an3.12:3.3: imāni kho bhikkhave tīṇi rañño khattiyassa muddhābhisittassa yāvajīvaṃ saraṇīyāni bhavanti.
an3.12:4.1: evameva kho bhikkhave tīṇīmāni bhikkhussa yāvajīvaṃ saraṇīyāni bhavanti
an3.12:4.3: yasmiṃ bhikkhave padese bhikkhu kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti
an3.12:4.4: idaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamaṃ bhikkhussa yāvajīvaṃ saraṇīyaṃ hoti.
an3.12:5.1: puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave yasmiṃ padese bhikkhu idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
an3.12:5.2: idaṃ bhikkhave dutiyaṃ bhikkhussa yāvajīvaṃ saraṇīyaṃ hoti.
an3.12:6.1: puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave yasmiṃ padese bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati
an3.12:6.2: idaṃ bhikkhave tatiyaṃ bhikkhussa yāvajīvaṃ saraṇīyaṃ hoti.
an3.12:6.3: imāni kho bhikkhave tīṇi bhikkhussa yāvajīvaṃ saraṇīyāni bhavantīti. 13
